sources.name: BIS IS 1239 Standard — web search summary 2026
sources.notes: Web search results from bis.gov.in confirm IS 1239 (Part 1) covers mild steel tubes (welded and seamless) for conveyance of water, gas, air and steam, classified as Light (Class A), Medium (Class B) and Heavy (Class C). Steel Tubes (Quality Control) Order 2020 mandates ISI mark. Tender explicitly cites 'IS 1239 / 90' for 50mm GI pipes Class B. This is a secondary search-result summary; no official gazette number confirmed.

sources.name: BIS IS 694:2010 Standard — web search summary 2026
sources.notes: Web search results from bis.gov.in confirm IS 694:2010 specifies PVC insulated unsheathed and sheathed cables/cords with rigid and flexible conductors for rated voltages up to 1100 V. BIS product manual referenced for IS 694:2010. Tender cites 'IS 694-1990' for flat 3-core PVC insulated cables. IS 694 has been revised to 2010 edition. This is a secondary search-result summary; no gazette number confirmed.

sources.name: BIS IS 1554 (Part 1):1988 Standard — web search summary 2026
sources.notes: Web search results from bis.gov.in confirm IS 1554 (Part 1):1988 covers PVC insulated heavy-duty electric cables for working voltages up to 1100 V (armoured and unarmoured). BIS certification is mandatory. Tender explicitly cites 'IS 1554/ 1988' for PVC insulated sheathed steel wire armoured LT UG cable. This is a secondary search-result summary.

sources.notes: Documents revision from IS 8034:2002 to IS 8034:2018. Records IS 9283, IS 14536, IS 11346 as normative references. Old edition withdrawal documented after 2019-04-04.

sources.notes: 2026 BIS MED 20 committee programme of work lists IS 8034:2018, IS 14220:2018, IS 9079:2018, IS 14536:2018, IS 9283, IS 11346, IS 10572 all under Committee MED 20.

sources.name: Pumps QCO 2023 — search-result summary
sources.publisher: Department for Promotion of Industry and Internal Trade (DPIIT)
sources.notes: Search results confirm a Pumps (Quality Control) Order 2023 was proposed by DPIIT covering IS 8034:2018 and IS 14220:2018, mandating ISI Mark. Enforcement date was cited as 'to be announced'. No official gazette number or effective date was confirmed in accessible sources. This record is a secondary summary only — not a primary gazette citation.

evidence.source_name: BIS IS 1239 Standard — web search summary 2026
evidence.text: IS 1239 (Part 1) covers mild steel tubes (welded and seamless, plain end, screwed end or screwed and socketed) for conveyance of water, gas, air and steam, in Class A (Light), Class B (Medium) and Class C (Heavy). Tubes may be supplied as uncoated or hot-dip galvanized (GI). Nominal bore 6 mm to 150 mm. Tender explicitly cites 'IS 1239 / 90' for 50mm GI pipes Class B for column pipe installation.

evidence.source_name: BIS IS 694:2010 Standard — web search summary 2026
evidence.text: IS 694:2010 specifies PVC insulated unsheathed and sheathed cables and cords (circular and flat) with rigid and flexible conductors for rated voltages up to and including 1100 V. Tender cites 'IS 694-1990' for flat 3-core sheathed PVC insulated submersible pump cable of sizes 2.5, 4 and 6 sq mm. IS 694 has been revised; current edition is IS 694:2010.

evidence.source_name: BIS IS 1554 (Part 1):1988 Standard — web search summary 2026
evidence.text: IS 1554 (Part 1):1988 covers PVC insulated heavy-duty electric cables (armoured and unarmoured) for working voltages up to 1100 V, used for electric supply and control including underground installation. Tender cites 'IS 1554/ 1988' for armoured LT UG cable (3.5x10 and 3.5x25 sq mm) for main connection.
BIS describes IS 14220:2018 as Openwell Submersible Pumpsets and discusses agriculture and irrigation applications.

evidence.source_name: BIS Government Procurement pump standards booklet
evidence.text: BIS describes IS 8034:2018 as Submersible Pumpsets used for clear, cold water in agriculture and water supply, commonly in boreholes/borewells/tubewells.

evidence.source_name: BIS Government Procurement pump standards booklet
evidence.text: BIS booklet identifies IS 9079:2018 as Monoset Pumps for Clear, Cold Water for Agricultural and Water Supply.
IS 8034:2002 was revised as IS 8034:2018 and the old standard would stand withdrawn after 04-04-2019.
IS 8034:2018 guideline records IS 9283 (line-operated a.c. motors for submersible pumpsets) as a normative reference for the motor component of submersible pumpsets.
IS 8034:2018 guideline records IS 14536 (Code of practice for selection, installation, operation and maintenance of submersible pumpset) as a normative reference.
IS 8034:2018 guideline records IS 11346 (Tests for agricultural and water supply pumps — Code of acceptance) as the hydraulic performance test method reference.
2026 BIS committee material lists revision work for IS 14220:2018.
2026 BIS committee material lists revision work for IS 8034:2018.
2026 BIS committee material lists revision work for IS 9079:2018.
BIS committee material lists IS 14536:2018 as Selection, installation, operation and maintenance of submersible pumpset - Code of practice (First Revision).

BIS MED 20 committee material lists IS 9283 (Line operated a.c. motors for submersible pumpsets — Specification) as a standard under the submersible pumpset committee. Current revision noted as IS 9283:2024 on BIS portal.
BIS MED 20 committee material lists IS 11346:2002 (Tests for agricultural and water supply pumps — Code of acceptance) as the hydraulic performance testing standard under Committee MED 20.
BIS MED 20 committee material lists IS 10572:1983 (Methods of sampling for pumps) as a sampling standard under Committee MED 20.

Secondary search results confirm Pumps (Quality Control) Order 2023 proposed by DPIIT covers IS 8034:2018 (Submersible Pumpsets) and IS 14220:2018 (Openwell Submersible Pumpsets), requiring ISI Mark under BIS Scheme-I. Enforcement date cited as 'to be announced'. No official gazette number or effective date confirmed.

standards.title: Openwell Submersible Pumpsets
standards.scope: Openwell submersible pumpsets for clear, cold water, including agriculture and irrigation applications described in BIS summary material.

standards.title: Submersible Pumpsets
standards.scope: Submersible pumpsets for clear, cold water, commonly used in boreholes/borewells/tubewells for agriculture and water supply.

standards.title: Monoset Pumps for Clear, Cold Water for Agricultural and Water Supply
standards.scope: Monoset pumps for clear, cold water for agricultural and water supply purposes.

standards.title: Selection, Installation, Operation and Maintenance of Submersible Pumpset — Code of Practice
standards.scope: Code of practice for selection, installation, operation and maintenance of submersible pumpset, as listed in BIS committee material.

standards.title: Line Operated A.C. Motors for Submersible Pumpsets — Specification
standards.scope: Specification for line-operated a.c. motors designed for use in submersible pumpsets. Normative reference of IS 8034:2018.

standards.title: Tests for Agricultural and Water Supply Pumps — Code of Acceptance
standards.scope: Code of acceptance for hydraulic performance testing of pumps used in agricultural and water supply applications. Referenced by IS 8034:2018 and IS 9079:2018.

standards.title: Methods of Sampling for Pumps
standards.scope: Methods of sampling and criteria for conformity for pumps, used in BIS certification under Committee MED 20.

standards.title: Mild Steel Tubes, Tubulars and Other Wrought Steel Fittings — Specification (Part 1: Mild Steel Tubes)
standards.scope: Specification for mild steel tubes (welded and seamless) for conveyance of water, gas, air and steam, classified as Class A (Light), Class B (Medium) and Class C (Heavy). Tubes may be uncoated or hot-dip galvanized (GI). Nominal bore 6 mm to 150 mm. Directly cited in the Ganga Kalyana Scheme tender for 50mm GI column pipes Class B.

standards.title: PVC Insulated Cables for Working Voltages up to and Including 1100 V
standards.scope: Specification for PVC insulated unsheathed and sheathed cables and cords (circular and flat) with rigid and flexible conductors for rated voltages up to 1100 V. Tender cites IS 694-1990 for flat 3-core sheathed PVC submersible pump cable. IS 694 has been revised to 2010 edition.

standards.title: PVC Insulated (Heavy Duty) Electric Cables (Part 1: For Working Voltages up to and Including 1100 V)
standards.scope: Specification for PVC insulated heavy-duty electric cables (armoured and unarmoured) for working voltages up to and including 1100 V, used for electric supply and control including underground installation. Tender cites 'IS 1554/1988' for armoured LT UG cable (3.5x10 and 3.5x25 sq mm).
